verdict.rationale: Datalab's pricing page lists "BAA / DPA" as included on the Team plan, which gives a HIPAA-oriented contractual option. Enterprise customers can also run the models on their own (air-gapped) infrastructure for regulated environments. The pack does not document zero-retention handling of uploaded documents or a SOC 2 attestation, so only a thin slice of the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: documented zero-retention or data-deletion policy for uploads, SOC 2 report or attestation, explicit HIPAA compliance documentation beyond a pricing-page BAA line, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a data engineer, uploaded documents get zero-retention handling with SOC 2 and HIPAA options, so I can process contracts and medical records
